name: Hill Titan
descr: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

data.motivesAndTactics: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.text: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.text: PCs are _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.
